name: 青蓝瓶盒同框清爽洗护款
description: 白底瓶盒同框起势，青蓝大字屏承接，痛点分屏到留空背书与收口

styleLock.direction: clean pharmacy-shelf haircare commerce with bold type panels
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF and pale ice #E8F4FA for packshots and spec screens, alternating with saturated cyan-blue #0C9BCB type panels carrying one soft radial glow
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even cool studio light, soft front key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows only, one sweeping highlight on macro, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte white seamless sweep #FFFFFF and matte pale ice board #E8F4FA, no reflective tabletop
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif in oversized headline blocks, one line only per panel
styleLock.iconSystem: hairline rules, empty seal frames and thin-line marks only, single accent color, no filled badges
styleLock.presentationRules: unit and its carton always displayed together at the same slight 3/4 or straight-on scale and placement, label facing the lens, never cropped
noDrift: no readable brand marks or invented numbers
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean haircare commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, pale ice #E8F4FA, saturated cyan-blue #0C9BCB panel fields and one marigold accent #F5A623; cool neutral studio tone; bright even key light from the front with soft fill and soft contact shadows only, one subtle radial glow behind products on cyan panels; matte white and pale ice surfaces; modern geometric sans-serif oversized headline blocks, one line per panel; hairline rules, empty seal frames and thin-line icons, no filled badges; product unit shown with its carton at a stable straight-on or slight 3/4 angle and unchanging scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no readable brand marks or invented numbers.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，瓶身与外盒同框交代真实到手形态
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, unit upright with its carton just behind, full pair visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key cool studio light, front key with soft fill card, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: White-background e-commerce packshot of {product}, the unit standing upright with its carton just behind it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view with the full pair visible and unclipped. Bright even high-key cool studio light from the front with a soft fill card, soft contact shadow grounding both pieces. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The pair occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace around the subject. 8K commercial haircare e-commerce quality. Negative: no text, no props, no hands, no watermark, no barcode or QR code, no lot or expiry digits, no invented label artwork, no cut-off edges, no floating product without a contact shadow.

shots.intent: 主图一秒法则，用青蓝底大字块把首要利益点一句话说清
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, pair pushed into the lower-right third
shots.lighting: bright even cool studio light, soft contact shadow, subtle radial glow behind the pair
shots.whitespace: generous clear space across the upper half for the headline block
shots.textZone: 顶部中央大字区，仅承载「{selling_point_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero on a saturated cyan-blue panel #0C9BCB: {product} shown at a slight 3/4 angle in the lower-right third with a soft radial glow behind it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One oversized headline block in #F5A623 held in the clear upper half, carrying only 「{selling_point_1}」. Bright even cool studio light with a soft contact shadow under the pair. The pair occupies 50-60% of the frame, generous negative space across the top for the headline and nothing else. Negative: no second claim, no dense body text, no invented multiples or percentages, no competitor marks, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 放大有日常头皮不适与形象顾虑的人群痛点，引发代入
shots.camera: from behind over the shoulder at eye level, face entirely out of frame
shots.lighting: soft window light from the left at 5500K, gentle shadow side, no clinical glare
shots.background: pale ice wall #E8F4FA with a cyan-blue #0C9BCB band along the bottom
shots.props: a blurred foreground shoulder edge as a scale anchor
shots.whitespace: clean lower band reserved for one line of copy
shots.textZone: 底部青蓝横幅条，仅承载「{selling_point_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point scene: a generic adult seen from behind at eye level, one hand parting the hair at the crown, face entirely out of frame. {product} placed small at the lower right beside its carton. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft window light from the left at 5500K with a gentle shadow side. Background pale ice wall #E8F4FA with a cyan-blue #0C9BCB band along the bottom carrying only 「{selling_point_2}」. Figure and product together occupy 40-50% of the frame, clean whitespace held in the lower band. Negative: no identifiable face, no celebrity likeness, no clinical scalp imagery, no invented statistics, no deformed fingers, no watermark, no extra text.

shots.intent: 用同机位双栏对照把困扰状态与产品方案并置，替代口头主张
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, identical framing and crop on both panels
shots.lighting: matched bright even cool light on both panels, soft contact shadow on the product side
shots.background: saturated cyan-blue #0C9BCB right panel with a pure white #FFFFFF left panel
shots.whitespace: whitespace kept clean above the right panel for one copy line
shots.textZone: 右栏上方主张位，仅承载「{selling_point_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison split screen, two matched panels with identical straight-on eye-level framing and identical light. Left panel: an everyday grooming moment on pure white #FFFFFF with a generic figure cropped below the chin. Right panel: {product} with its carton on saturated cyan-blue #0C9BCB under a soft radial glow. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A single hairline divider in #F5A623 runs between the panels, and the upper right panel is reserved for 「{selling_point_3}」. Each panel carries 50-60% of its own frame with clean whitespace above the right panel. Negative: no fabricated results, no close-up scalp or skin condition imagery, no real competitor marks, no readable claims, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 以中央产品加六向细线标注的信息图结构，一次交代多个利益点位置
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle centred in frame, callout rails on both sides
shots.lighting: bright even cool studio light, flat and readable, soft contact shadow
shots.props: six short label slots joined by hairline rules in #0C9BCB
shots.whitespace: structured side margins, no extra whitespace beyond the label columns
shots.textZone: 左右各三条细线标注位，仅承载「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」与「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」「{callout_6}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce feature-callout infographic of {product} with its carton at a slight 3/4 hero angle centred in the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Six short label slots, three on each side, each joined to the pair by a hairline rule in #0C9BCB, holding only 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 on the left and 「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」「{callout_6}」 on the right. Background pale ice panel #E8F4FA, bright even cool light, soft contact shadow grounding the pair. The pair occupies 50-60% of the frame, structured side margins and no extra whitespace beyond the label columns. Negative: no dense body text, no tiny unreadable type, no invented ingredient names or percentages, no fake certifications, no overlapping rules, no watermark.

shots.intent: 微距证明封口与瓶肩做工，消除材质与泄漏疑虑
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on the closure and shoulder seam, from a very low angle
shots.lighting: shallow depth of field at f/3.2, skimming side light from the right with one sweeping highlight
shots.whitespace: minimal, the detail is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the closure and shoulder of {product}, tight zoom on the mould seam and edge finish, photographed from a very low angle. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field at f/3.2 with the near edge sharp, skimming side light from the right producing one sweeping highlight along the shoulder. Background saturated cyan-blue #0C9BCB. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, minimal whitespace since the detail is the subject. Negative: no blurry subject, no duplicated cap, no visible wording on the closure, no over-smoothed plastic sheen, no water droplets implying contents, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 三行适配清单让人对号入座自选，替代口头适用范围主张
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down on the pair, upright list column at the right
shots.lighting: bright even cool studio light, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
shots.props: one plain hairbrush resting beside the pair, three hairline rules in #0C9BCB
shots.whitespace: clean right column margin, no extra whitespace beyond it
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce compatibility screen photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down at {product} and its carton, with one plain hairbrush resting beside them. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Three stacked short rows on the right separated by hairline rules in #0C9BCB, carrying only 「{callout_7}」「{callout_8}」「{callout_9}」. Background seamless pure white #FFFFFF, bright even cool studio light, soft contact shadows. The group occupies 60-70% overall with a clean right column margin and no extra whitespace beyond it. Negative: no identifiable face, no hands, no invented suitability claims, no dense body text, no duplicated brush, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 复刻外盒背面表格式信息结构但全部留空，满足看说明的心理需求又不编造内容
shots.camera: flat lay from directly above at a 90-degree overhead angle, carton panel facing the lens
shots.lighting: even flat high-key light, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: empty ruled grid with blank rows and blank indicator bars
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace beyond even margins on all four sides
shots.textZone: 中部空表格外框与空参数行，不出字
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce back-panel spec screen, flat lay shot from directly above at a 90-degree overhead angle showing the carton panel of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The panel is rendered as an empty ruled grid: blank parameter rows, empty table cells, blank indicator bars, no readable words anywhere. Background saturated cyan-blue #0C9BCB, even flat high-key light with no dramatic shadow. The flat carton occupies 35-40% of the frame with even margins on all four sides and no extra whitespace beyond them. Negative: no legible body text, no garbled micro-copy, no phone numbers, no barcode or QR code, no ingredient or dosage lists, no invented regulatory marks, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用留空印章框与指示条承接信任信息位，降风险但不编造资质
shots.camera: very low angle looking upward at the pair, centred
shots.lighting: bright even cool studio light, soft contact shadow grounding the pair
shots.props: three empty seal frames outlined in hairline #0C9BCB
shots.whitespace: generous whitespace in the upper third for one copy line
shots.textZone: 上方一行主张位，仅承载「{selling_point_4}」；三枚印章框留空
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen: {product} with its carton photographed from a very low angle looking upward on seamless pure white #FFFFFF. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Three stacked proof rows behind them drawn as empty seal frames and blank indicator bars outlined in hairline #0C9BCB, with a single short line above holding only 「{selling_point_4}」. Bright even cool studio light with a soft contact shadow grounding the pair. The pair occupies 50-60% of the frame with generous whitespace in the upper third. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings, review counts, lab or clinical results; no badge artwork, no star strips, no platform marks, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 收口促单，瓶盒成组同框加留空按钮位承接行动指令
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, pair centred low in frame
shots.lighting: bright even cool studio light, soft contact shadow, subtle radial glow behind the pair
shots.props: one blank rounded button shape below the product
shots.whitespace: clear space reserved above and below the pair for copy lines
shots.textZone: 上方主张位与下方按钮条，仅承载「{selling_point_5}」与「{callout_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close of {product} with its carton, straight-on eye-level and centred low in the frame on saturated cyan-blue #0C9BCB with a soft radial glow. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One headline block in #F5A623 reading only 「{selling_point_5}」 and a blank rounded button shape below the pair holding only 「{callout_1}」. Bright even cool studio light with a soft contact shadow. The pair occupies 50-60% of the frame with clear space reserved above and below for the two copy lines. Negative: no invented discounts, countdowns or price tags, no star ratings or platform badges, no dense body text, no cut-off carton edges, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 10 张源主图逐图事实：01 白底瓶身与外盒同框平铺主图，标签正面、右下角有方形码与批号字样；02 青蓝底上半部大字主张屏，产品对在右下并带径向光晕；03 同色底纯文字超大数字主张屏并带脚注行；04 中央立盒加左右各三条细线利益点的信息图；05 左人物右青蓝产品栏的双栏屏；06 镜前抬手拨发的自查场景加底部青蓝文字条；07 左梳发人物右三行清单的双栏屏；08 户外拥抱的发丝场景加底部青蓝文字条；09 青蓝底三行细线分隔的主张堆叠屏；10 外盒背面密集说明表格平铺屏（黑色表格框与客服电话）。品类判定依据：以图为准，主体是翻盖瓶装淋洗类发用产品及其外盒，使用形态为洗头护理，故归护肤个护/洗护发，不按源平台常挂的医药类目处理。已剥离内容：品牌字标与系列名、瓶身盒面及屏上的全部原文案与原句、容量与批号字样、二维码与客服电话、四张人物图中可辨识的面容与身份（改写为背影、颈部以下裁切或无面部构图）、以及头皮洁净类功效主张与药品成分含量类事实（一律改为 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 空位或空白证明占位、空表格单元、留空印章框与留空指示条），产品一律以 {product} 占位；源平台店铺字样与评分角标未纳入。
